title: Preserve independent revision and lifecycle records after a merge
preconditions: Create checkout r1/proposed in an isolated Saga; create two branch-local r1 children with distinct definitions and accepted/rejected lifecycle children, then merge those immutable records as the test fixtures do.

steps.expected_result: Both revision heads remain present, revision_conflict is true, and there is no fabricated current revision.
Both event branches remain separate, lifecycle_conflict is true, and no current lifecycle winner is selected.

steps.action: Inspect the separate immutable revision and event records in the fixture and compare their original bytes.
steps.expected_result: Each record retains its identity and complete content; no branch overwrote the other.

expected_result: Concurrent branch histories remain explicit instead of last-writer-wins.
